prompt.en: These 3 diagrams were drafted quickly in draw.io and look too plain for a client deck — same for all three: clean up the visual hierarchy, give each zone/layer a clearer color scheme, and make them presentation-ready without changing the underlying logic.
prompt.zh: 这 3 张图是用 draw.io 快速画的草稿，配色和排版比较简陋，不太能直接放进给客户的汇报材料。麻烦帮我统一美化一下：理清各分层/分区的视觉层级，配色更专业一些，逻辑不要改，做成可以直接拿去汇报的效果。

reply.en: Polished all 3 diagrams: rebuilt each as a color-coded, presentation-ready visual with consistent typography and clearer zone grouping, while keeping every component, connection, and label unchanged — just the Noumi product architecture, the on-premises deployment network topology, and the backup & recovery architecture.
reply.zh: 已完成 3 张图的美化：统一了字体和分区配色，用更清晰的色块划分各层/各区域，组件、连线和文案内容全部保留不变——分别是 Noumi 产品架构图、本地化部署网络拓扑图、备份与容灾架构图。
